_readme: The only file you edit to turn advertising on. Nothing else on the site knows an ad network exists. See MONETISATION.md.

interstitial._note: The panel shown while a game loads. It is the most valuable slot on a games site and the least annoying place to put one, because the player is already waiting.
interstitial._minGap: Never show it twice inside this many minutes, however many games are opened.

houseAds._note: Shown in every slot that has no network id yet, instead of a dashed placeholder. They promote your own games, which is worth more than an empty box - and on a LIVE site a dashed box labelled advert reads as broken. Set false to go back to placeholders.
